verdict_text: NO. The regex `matrix_re` omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight` from its alternation, so o_proj weights (16 tensors, one per layer) are never cast to bfloat16, leaving only 96 tensors in bfloat16 instead of the required 112, violating Required Result clause 1 and Required Checks clause 1. The script's own assertion also asserts 96 rather than 112, so it "passes" its self-check while implementing the wrong spec. This will fail grading since o_proj weights should be bfloat16 but remain float32, and the count check itself contradicts the spec's "exactly 112" requirement.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
